summary: Worlds created with seed "REDApRES" (0) crash when trying to load new 1.18 mountain biomes java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "dfw.a(double, double, double)" because "this.a" is null
description: Basically the title. This doesn t affect any cave biomes. To recreate this you just have to enter "REDApRES" into the seed field and create a new world. After that you can locate and tp walk to any of the new mountain biomes except Meadow and the world will crash. I tried this on a server and the error was "java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "dfw.a(double, double, double)" because "this.a" is null" and the server closed with error code "255". I understand that technically seed "0" isn t even supposed to be entered but it have worked with all previous versions so I think this crash counts as a bug. My guess is that this new mountain generation is completely based on the raw seed so there probably won t be any fix for this bug but I am still reporting it because I often use it and I got hope. Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new world with the seed "REDApRES" (0).
3. Enter Creative mode by using the command `/gamemode creative`.
4. Fly to an area in the world that contains one of the new 1.18 mountain biomes, excluding Meadow.
5. Walk into the identified mountain biome.
6. Observe that the game crashes with a `java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "dfw.a(double, double, double)" because "this.a" is null` error message.
7. Note the crash and record any additional details or screenshots if necessary.
Observed Behavior: When creating a world with the seed "REDApRES" (which corresponds to the numerical value 0), attempting to load new mountain biomes introduced in Minecraft version 1.18 results in a crash due to a `java.lang.NullPointerException`. This issue specifically occurs when trying to generate chunks containing these new mountain biomes, except for the Meadow biome. The error message indicates that the method "dfw.a(double, double, double)" cannot be invoked because "this.a" is null. This problem does not affect cave biomes or any other types of biomes within the world. To reproduce this issue, one simply needs to input "REDApRES" as the seed when creating a new world and then navigate to any of the affected mountain biomes. On servers, attempting to load these areas results in an error message with the same NullPointerException, leading to the server shutting down with error code 255. Despite the fact that entering a seed value of "0" is not officially supported, this particular combination has worked seamlessly in previous versions, making it reasonable to consider this crash as a bug. The stack trace from the crash log provides detailed information about the exception occurring during chunk generation and can be found in the file named "crash-2021-09-21_15.04.25-server.txt".
Expected Behavior: When creating a world with the seed "REDApRES" (0), the game should load and allow exploration of all new mountain biomes in version 1.18 without crashing. The player should be able to teleport or walk into these biomes, including all mountains except Meadow, without encountering any java.lang.NullPointerException errors, ensuring stable gameplay both single-player and on servers.
